title: Effect of Anti-inflammatory (ITIS) Diet in Knee Osteoarthritis
official: Effect of Anti-inflammatory (ITIS) Diet in Knee Osteoarthritis
summary: To study the effect of anti-inflammatory diet on clinical and biological outcomes in patients with knee osteoarthritis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed of Knee Ostoeaarthritis
* without changes in treatment in the last 3 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* food allergies
* pregnancy
